label: Podcast Show
description: A podcast, as its RSS feed describes it. One row per show, keyed on the show's stable identifier rather than its feed address, so a move between hosts does not create a second show. Episodes join it through the in-collection edge. Mirrors the channel element of an RSS 2.0 feed together with the iTunes and Podcasting 2.0 namespaces, for upstream fidelity; a connection that would rather trade fidelity for interoperability writes `core.media.series` instead.

title.description: Show name (maps to the channel `title`). A feed that omits it falls back to its host, since a show with no name cannot be told apart in a list.

feed_url.description: Address the feed was fetched from. Not the identity: a show that changes host keeps its guid and changes this.

podcast_guid.description: Stable identifier for the show, from the channel's `podcast:guid` where the feed declares one. Where it does not — which is most feeds — this is the same value computed the way the Podcasting 2.0 specification defines it, as a UUIDv5 over the feed address with the scheme and any trailing slash removed. A feed that later adds a conformant guid therefore lands on the value already stored.

link.description: The show's own web page (maps to the channel `link`). Distinct from `feed_url`, which is the machine-readable feed.

description.description: Show description, preferring `itunes:summary` and falling back to the channel `description`.

author.description: Who makes the show (maps to `itunes:author`, falling back to `managingEditor`, which is an address rather than a name and so is only a fallback).

owner_name.description: Name on the feed's ownership record (maps to `itunes:owner` / `itunes:name`). The owner's email address is deliberately not mirrored.

image_url.description: Show artwork, from the `href` attribute of `itunes:image`, falling back to the channel `image` block. The iTunes element carries its value in an attribute and has no text content.

language.description: Language tag exactly as the feed gave it (maps to the channel `language`). Not corrected to canonical case, because a feed saying `en-us` is data about the feed.

categories.description: Category names from `itunes:category`, including nested subcategories, flattened to a list of the `text` attributes.

itunes_type.description: Whether episodes are meant to be read newest-first or from the beginning (maps to `itunes:type`). Says nothing about audio versus video — that is carried per episode by the enclosure's MIME type.

complete.description: Whether the feed declares that no further episodes will ever appear (maps to `itunes:complete`, which is present and set to yes, or absent).

explicit.description: Explicitness as declared by `itunes:explicit`. Normalized case-insensitively: yes and true become `true`, no and false become `false`, and `clean` is preserved because it asserts the absence of explicit content rather than merely not claiming it.

new_feed_url.description: Address the feed asks clients to move to (maps to `itunes:new-feed-url`). Recorded and surfaced for a person to act on, never followed automatically: a feed naming its own replacement is an instruction from an untrusted document.

last_build_date.description: When the feed says its contents last changed (maps to the channel `lastBuildDate`). Advisory only — some hosts omit it and others regenerate it on every render, so it is not used to decide whether to re-read a feed.

episode_count.description: How many items the feed carried when it was last read. Not the show's episode count: some hosts publish only a recent window, and nothing in a feed says it has been truncated.
